hostile_cases.method: Executable negative fixture rejected numeric value under UNKNOWN semantics.
Executable negative fixture rejected taxonomic class asserted as quantitative material abundance.
All regional/site/sample assertions carry body-scoped region and observation links; coverage labels are lanes, not global inventory claims.
Evidence notes and contexts preserve sampled surface, coma, plume, drill, and spectral scope; no bulk conversion is emitted.
Four inference/model lanes retain their original epistemic class; no model output is relabeled direct.
No non-detection/absence assertions were admitted; all unsupported lanes remain UNKNOWN_AFTER_SEARCH.
No winner/preferred_fact is selected; inherited evidence rows are preserved exactly and new rows are appended as CANDIDATE.
Source, observation, region, DOI/URL, lineage and artifact hashes are retained; raw artifacts without verified redistribution rights are not committed.
Executable SQLite/body-reference consistency checks and foreign_key_check pass.
Every acquired artifact has an exact path, size and SHA-256 record; lineage count is reported separately from assertion count.
No abundance ranges or unqualified numeric abundance are introduced; validator rejects reversed bounds and quantified values without units.
Inventory uses existing candidate mass or candidate size+bulk density only; no taxonomy-derived mass/density.
Executable negative fixture detects resource/economic score fields; schema scan finds none of the prohibited downstream fields.
Campaign validator rejects duplicate assertion keys.
All assertions must refer to the frozen 110-object catalog; resulting candidate remains exactly 110 bodies.
